headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.15
summary: The Discord Rich Presence login button now works in release builds, and the Discord settings stay fully hidden on builds without it.

items.text: The Discord login button was missing in release builds; the Discord client id is now injected into every CI build.
The Discord settings rows now hide completely on builds without a Discord client id instead of leaving a bare title behind.
